root_cause: The connector API began exposing pending cross-domain ESG/privacy/security/finance reviews, but the monitor UI counted synthetic review rows against the wrong connector and the activation page could misleadingly present a TEST_PASSED draft as ready even when the canonical impact review remained pending.
prevention: Filter review rows strictly by connectorId/connector_id rather than counting unrelated synthetic entries.
Show only allowlisted impact domains and safely formatted ESRS candidates, never actor, changeId or raw audit payload.
Disable activation call-to-action in the view while the latest persisted impact is REVIEW_REQUIRED; server retains authoritative fail-closed guard.
Never claim CSRD legal applicability, verified ESG materiality or measured emissions from pending review topics.

evidence.outcome: Pending connector reviews become intelligible and tenant-connector scoped; real regulatory sign-off is still outstanding.
